note: State-level only. Federal brackets, FICA and local taxes are applied separately by the calculator this data was built for.

states.name: Alabama
notes: Alabama is one of three states that still lets you deduct federal income tax.
Overtime pay was exempt from Alabama withholding through 30 Jun 2025.

states.name: Alaska
notes: No state income tax. Alaska is the only state where employees pay part of unemployment insurance.

states.name: Arkansas
notes: Top rate cut to 3.9% effective TY2025 (Act 1 of the 2024 second extraordinary session).

states.name: California

payrollTaxes.name: State Disability Insurance
payrollTaxes.note: The SDI wage cap was removed in 2024 — this applies to every dollar earned.

notes: The 1% Mental Health Services surtax pushes the top marginal rate to 13.3%.
DERIVED: head-of-household brackets indexed from the published single schedule.
states.source: California FTB 2026 tax rate schedules; EDD 2026 SDI rate (1.3%)

states.name: Colorado
notes: Colorado taxes federal taxable income, so your federal standard deduction carries over.

states.name: Connecticut
notes: Connecticut has no standard deduction; the personal exemption phases out completely at higher incomes.
A separate benefit-recapture provision can claw back the value of lower brackets above $200k.

states.name: District of Columbia

payrollTaxes.name: Paid Family Leave
payrollTaxes.note: Employer-funded in DC — no employee deduction.

notes: DC brackets are identical for every filing status.

states.name: Florida
notes: No state income tax. Florida funds itself largely through sales and tourism taxes.

states.name: Georgia
notes: HB 463, signed 11 May 2026 and retroactive to 1 January 2026, cut the flat rate from 5.19% to 4.99%; it falls a further 0.125 points a year toward 3.99% subject to revenue triggers.
The standard deduction rises to $15,000 / $30,000 in 2027 under the same bill.

states.name: Hawaii

payrollTaxes.name: Temporary Disability Insurance
payrollTaxes.note: 0.5% of weekly wages, capped at a $1,500.21 weekly maximum — $390.05 a year.

notes: Act 46 (2024) is phasing in large bracket widenings through 2031.
states.source: Hawaii DOTAX, Act 46 SLH 2024; 2026 TDI weekly maximum

states.name: Idaho
notes: Rate cut from 5.695% to 5.3% for TY2025 (HB 40).
states.source: Idaho STC, HB 40 (2025); 2026 rate unchanged at 5.3%

states.name: Illinois
notes: The exemption allowance is fully disallowed above $250k ($500k joint).

states.name: Indiana
notes: Every Indiana county levies its own income tax, from 0.5% to 3.0%.
The statewide average of ~1.60% is applied by default.

states.name: Iowa
notes: Iowa completed its move to a 3.8% flat tax in TY2025, two years early.
states.source: Iowa DOR, SF 2442 (2024); 2026 rate unchanged at 3.8%

states.name: Kansas
states.source: Kansas DOR, SB 1 (2024 special session); 2026 schedule

states.name: Kentucky
notes: Rate dropped to 3.5% on 1 January 2026; most Kentucky cities add an occupational licence tax on top.

states.name: Louisiana
notes: Louisiana replaced its three-bracket system with a 3% flat tax for TY2025 and repealed the federal income tax deduction (HB 10, 2024 special session).

states.name: Maine

payrollTaxes.name: Paid Family & Medical Leave (employee share)
payrollTaxes.note: Premiums began 1 Jan 2025; benefits begin May 2026.

states.source: Maine Revenue Services, 2025 individual income tax rates

states.name: Maryland
notes: Every Maryland county levies a local income tax between 2.25% and 3.20%. Baltimore City is applied by default.
Two brackets — 6.25% and 6.50% — were added for high earners, retroactive to 2025.
DERIVED: the joint thresholds for those two new brackets are scaled from the single table.
states.source: Comptroller of Maryland, 2026 rate schedule and local tax rate chart

states.name: Massachusetts
states.source: Massachusetts DOR, TIR 24-12; 2026 PFML employee rate 0.46% (medical 0.28% + family 0.18%). Millionaires-tax threshold as of 2025, pending 2026 indexation.

states.name: Mississippi
notes: The first $10,000 of taxable income is exempt; the rate fell to 4.0% on 1 January 2026 and continues stepping toward zero.

states.name: Montana
notes: The top rate fell from 5.9% to 5.65% on 1 January 2026 and is legislated to reach 5.4% in 2027.
DERIVED: joint and head-of-household thresholds are the statutory 2x and 1.5x multiples of the single table.

states.name: Nebraska
notes: The top rate fell from 5.20% to 4.55% on 1 January 2026 and the schedule collapsed from four brackets to three; it is legislated to reach 3.99% in 2027 (LB 754).
DERIVED: joint and head-of-household thresholds are scaled from the published single table.
states.source: Nebraska DOR, 2026 individual income tax rate schedule

states.name: Nevada
notes: No state income tax.

states.name: New Hampshire
notes: No tax on wages. The 3% interest & dividends tax was fully repealed effective 2025.

states.name: New Jersey
notes: New Jersey has no standard deduction and taxes gross income with very few subtractions.
states.source: New Jersey Division of Taxation, NJ-1040 instructions 2026; NJ DOLWD 2026 TDI/FLI/UI rates

states.name: New Mexico
notes: HB 252 (2024) restructured the brackets from TY2025, widening the low-rate tiers.

states.name: New York
notes: New York City residents owe a separate city income tax on top of state tax — the single biggest swing factor in a New York take-home figure.
The five lowest brackets were cut for TY2026; the top three are unchanged.
states.source: New York DTF, IT-201 instructions 2026; NYS PFL 2026 rate and cap

states.name: North Carolina
notes: The phased reduction to a flat 3.99% completed on 1 January 2026; further cuts depend on revenue triggers.

states.name: North Dakota
notes: North Dakota has the lowest top income tax rate of any state that levies one.

states.name: Ohio
notes: Ohio completed its move to a single 2.75% rate on 1 January 2026; the first $26,050 of income remains untaxed and municipal and school-district levies are separate.

states.name: Oklahoma
notes: HB 2764 collapsed six brackets into three and cut the top rate from 4.75% to 4.5%, effective 1 January 2026.

states.name: Oregon

payrollTaxes.name: Statewide transit tax
payrollTaxes.note: Applies to every dollar of wages.

notes: Oregon has no sales tax but the highest bottom-bracket rate in the country.
states.source: Oregon DOR, 2026 personal income tax rates

states.name: Pennsylvania
notes: Pennsylvania allows no standard deduction and no personal exemption, but nearly every municipality adds a local earned income tax.

states.name: Rhode Island
states.source: Rhode Island DOR, 2026 tax rate schedule; RI DLT 2026 TDI rate and wage base

states.name: South Carolina
notes: South Carolina starts from federal taxable income; the top rate reached 6.0% for TY2026.

states.name: South Dakota
notes: No state income tax.

states.name: Tennessee
notes: No state income tax. The Hall income tax on investment income ended in 2021.

states.name: Texas
notes: No state income tax — the Texas constitution requires a referendum to create one.

states.name: Utah
notes: Utah replaces deductions with a taxpayer credit worth 6% of the federal standard deduction, which phases out as income rises.
The rate fell from 4.55% to 4.50% for TY2026.

states.name: Virginia
notes: Virginia's top bracket starts at just $17,000, so almost every full-time worker pays the 5.75% marginal rate.

states.name: Washington

payrollTaxes.name: WA Cares long-term care premium
payrollTaxes.note: Applies to all wages; opt-outs closed in 2022.

notes: No income tax on wages. A 7% capital gains excise tax applies to large investment gains only.

states.name: West Virginia
notes: A revenue-triggered 4% across-the-board cut took effect for TY2025.
states.source: West Virginia Tax Division, 2026 rate schedule

states.name: Wisconsin
notes: Wisconsin's standard deduction shrinks as income rises and disappears entirely for higher earners.
The second bracket was widened sharply for TY2026, moving a large band of income from 5.3% to 4.4%.
DERIVED: the joint schedule is scaled from the published single table.
states.source: Wisconsin DOR, 2026 standard deduction and rate tables

states.name: Wyoming
notes: No state income tax.
